note: springdoc-openapi integration. With springdoc on the classpath (an optional, compile-only dependency of the bridge) the Rust routes appear in the application's Swagger UI: the bridge fetches each documented app's document in-process from its vespera!(spec_url = ...) route (vespera.bridge.springdoc.spec-path, default /openapi.json; or a custom VesperaOpenApiSource bean). mode=group (default) adds one Swagger UI definition per app (_default + exposed-apps) served verbatim at /v3/api-docs/vespera/<app>, keeping springdoc's own document; mode=merge merges paths, components (clashes prefixed, $refs rewritten) and tags into springdoc's /v3/api-docs, adding the app header parameter to named apps' operations. The proxy's /** catch-all is hidden from springdoc's document.
